# todoi

> todoi is a task manager: project groups hold projects, projects hold lists, and lists hold items, shown as a List, Board or Calendar. AI agents and scripts use the versioned JSON API at https://todoi.com/api/v1 with a personal API token, read only or read and write, for every project or only some.

## Docs

- [todoi for agents (Markdown)](https://todoi.com/docs/agents.md): how an AI agent authenticates with an API token, the main API endpoints, and the rules to follow
- [todoi for agents (web page)](https://todoi.com/docs/agents): the same guide as a page in the app
- [How todoi works](https://todoi.com/docs): the basics of using todoi, on one page
- [API v1 (OpenAPI 3.1)](https://todoi.com/api/v1/openapi.json): every operation of the versioned API with its parameters and fields
